release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.1.0 — Science Exhibition & Final Production Master:
• Resolved route collision: converted role layouts (student, parent, teacher, admin) to explicit /login fallback redirect, eliminating infinite loop on unauthenticated boot.
• Removed NativeWind CSS transitions without Reanimated dependency, ensuring pure native stability across all Android devices.
• Added 1-tap 'Instant Exhibition Demo ⚡' directly on Landing Screen for immediate offline presentation to judges/investors without logging in.
• Protected MainActivity super.onCreate with robust exception fallback.
• Signed with official keystore (v2/v3 schemes), Target SDK 34, 100% Google Play Protect compliant.
